verdict.rationale: Crossmint's own platform is proprietary, but its agent wallets speak open machine-payment protocols. It pays x402-protected endpoints through the @x402/core client and MPP endpoints through the mppx client via Tempo. It also relies on card-network agent rails (Visa Intelligent Commerce, Mastercard Agent Pay). That shows participation in multi-party protocols rather than a purely private integration, but nothing in the evidence shows independent parties implementing Crossmint's own API, and none of these sources establish that the protocols themselves have two or more independent implementers. Missing for 10: evidence of at least two named independent implementers of the protocol/platform, an open published spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), and independent corroboration of ecosystem adoption.
